name: v2.2.0-beta (beta)
body:
## Beta Release

This is a **beta** release for testing the state machine refactor. It contains no user-facing behavior changes — the UX is identical to v2.1.2. The internals have been completely rewritten for reliability.

### What Changed (Internal)

- **Formal state machine** — all app state flows through validated transitions
- **Single input gate** — every recording trigger (hotkey, pill, tray, UI) goes through one check
- **Stateless pill** — pill widget has zero local state, receives render commands from main
- **Event-driven transitions** — UI acknowledges state changes instead of relying on timers
- **Sidecar auto-recovery** — no more permanent "Already recording" stuck state
- **78 torture tests** — double-click, rapid toggles, concurrent calls, crash recovery

### Why Beta

Internal refactor needs real-world testing before stable release. If you encounter any issues, please report them.

**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Zbrooklyn/WhisperClick-Desktop-App/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Zbrooklyn/WhisperClick-Desktop-App/compare/v2.0.1...v2.2.0-beta

name: v2.1.0
body:
## What's New

### Auto-Enter Mode
After transcription pastes your text, WhisperClick can now optionally press Enter for you:
- **Off** (default) — no change, you press Enter yourself
- **Button** — a red Enter (↵) button appears briefly after transcription. Click to send.
- **Auto** — Enter fires automatically after a smart delay. Fully hands-free.

Configure in Settings → Quick Settings → Auto-Enter.

### Stability Fixes
- Pill widget no longer disappears after extended use
- Timer no longer shows phantom counting when reopening the app
- Tooltip no longer lingers after interactions
- Fixed crash dialog from auto-updater in dev mode

### Website & Documentation
- [Getting Started guide](https://github.com/Zbrooklyn/WhisperClick-Desktop-App/blob/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md)
- [FAQ & Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Zbrooklyn/WhisperClick-Desktop-App/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md)
- Website support section added at [whisperclick.com](https://whisperclick.com)
